scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm --filter lnkz build && pnpm --filter lnkz-mcp build && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter lnkz --filter lnkz-mcp --filter @workspace/api-server --filter @workspace/mobile --filter ./scripts --if-present run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter lnkz test && pnpm --filter lnkz-mcp test && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server test && pnpm --filter @workspace/mobile test
